LingYu Real-World Robotics Dataset
	


	
		
	
	
		1. Introduction
	

LingYu Real-World Robotics Dataset provides real-world teleoperation data for research in imitation learning and task-specific policy adaptation. In this first release, we are open-sourcing 139.4 hours of high-quality bimanual first-person teleoperation data (13,200+ episodes) spanning 15 tabletop task families and 22 subsets, covering deformable-object manipulation, fine-grained and precision manipulation, as… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/LingYu-Robotics/lingyu-realworld-robotics-dataset.
